name: postoir
description: Postoir is a social media management platform for creating, organizing, scheduling, and publishing content across multiple social networks.

interface.shortDescription: Draft, schedule, and publish social posts
interface.longDescription: Postoir connects an assistant to a Postoir workspace. Resolve accounts, create drafts, attach media, schedule or publish, and check delivery. The client handles sign-in. An accepted publication is not proof of delivery.
defaultPrompt: List my Postoir accounts and create a draft. Do not publish yet.
Schedule a post for one of my connected social accounts at a date and time I provide.
Check my latest Postoir publications and summarize the delivery status for every destination.
